title: Arkret Bottom Diagnostics
description: Non-authoritative diagnostic for unresolved ordinary projections or verification failures. This object never replaces a canonical Cell state, a confirmed security command outcome, or a safety recovery protocol.

kind.description: Projection diagnostic only. Concurrent ordinary causal heads may require domain resolution; missing dependencies remain pending; unauthorized inputs are quarantined or rejected. Safety commands have durable committed/rejected outcomes and never join into a competing authority value.

cell_ids.description: Exact Cell ids involved in the diagnostic. A failed security command has its separate durable outcome and does not write this diagnostic into those Cells.

event_ids.description: Event identities involved in the diagnostic. Absence does not establish an unwritten Cell or authorize an operation.

seal_view.description: Confirmed safety basis at observation, with exactly one head per Realm. Ordinary projection replay additionally requires the complete eligible Event evidence; these leaves alone do not reproduce ordinary data state.

state_root.description: Optional confirmed safety state_root for a single Realm only. It is not an ordinary data or diagnostic root.

heads.description: Candidate values for an unresolved ordinary causal projection. Distinct head identities are retained even for equal values; no arrival-order winner is selected. This diagnostic does not replace canonical Cell state.

details.description: Free-form structured details specific to the diagnostic kind. Producers SHOULD use stable keys per kind (e.g. invalid_transition: from/to/expected_transitions; schema_error: schema_id/violation_path). Receivers MAY display but MUST NOT use for authorization decisions.

escalated_at.description: When the cell first crossed Realm.bottom_escalation_after_ms. Absent when within the grace window. Implementations SHOULD raise an out-of-band notification to admins / recovery governance once set.
